name: ModelVariant147_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant147_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the entry raises a rippling, colour-faded grid under the slot, grows a tube of strips with spinning spokes and fading sparks towards the other slot, sweeps two beams along a spiral path and ends on a fading screen flash. A negative command draws a frame; any other command sets the work area up and prints its size); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-164 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant164_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x1C lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
